fields.local_police_station: Auroville Police Station (Vanur sub-division, Villupuram district, Tamil Nadu — Auroville township straddles the TN/Puducherry border but the township + Matrimandir lie inside Villupuram district TN)
fields.nearest_hospital: JIPMER (Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education & Research), Gorimedu, Puducherry
fields.rescue_contact: Auroville Security & Emergency Services (ASES) 24/7: +91 9443090107 / Auroville Ambulance: +91 94422-24680

notes: Auroville township + Matrimandir are 6 km west of ECR-Bommayapalayam turnoff in Vanur taluk, Villupuram district, Tamil Nadu (NOT Puducherry UT proper) — confirmed by mappls.com listing 605111 + Wikipedia + auroville.org. Auroville Police Station phone 0413-2677318 and Kottakuppam PS 0413-2236148 listed on auroville.org/page/emergency-numbers-and-services as official jurisdiction stations — kept name only because the auroville.org page is the township admin's own emergency directory not a govt police directory. ASES (Auroville Security & Emergency Services) 9443090107 + Ambulance 9442224680 + Health Centre 0413-2622018 all from same official Auroville page — these ARE the township's primary emergency contact pathway. Nearest tertiary ER = JIPMER Gorimedu (12 km south) or PIMS (Pondicherry Institute of Medical Sciences) ~15 km. JIPMER casualty 0413-2272142 + 24/7 emergency referral 0413-2296568 confirmed via search but not webfetched on jipmer.edu.in (cert error) so kept off payload as named hospital only. Pharmacy/mechanic/tow not on auroville.org emergency page → null.
